blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: For many people, discovering everything Tanzania has to offer is a dream. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari to spot Africa’s Big Five, climbing Kilimanjaro or unwinding on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar, you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news: Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that matches all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Looking for inspiration? Our most popular itineraries are a good place to start. Most of our clients like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: You can pick from our popular Tanzania itineraries or have us shape the journey around you; either way, we are ready to help. Come along and prepare to explore Tanzania in your own time and in exactly the style you prefer!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you when you land at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel so you can rest after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb starts, you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on clothing, packing and other useful tips to make the climb as comfortable as possible for you.

blocks.orig: Today, your driver picks you up at the hotel and takes you to the Umbwe Gate to complete the registration formalities. The Kilimanjaro climb begins through dense rainforest, where you can hear and spot various animals. As you approach the Umbwe River, the route becomes steeper, offering views of Kibo Peak in the distance and the deep valleys surrounding you. The climb ends after 5-7 hours at Umbwe Cave Camp.
blocks.html: Today your driver collects you from the hotel and drives you to the Umbwe Gate, where you complete the registration formalities. Your Kilimanjaro climb starts in dense rainforest, where various animals can be heard and seen. Closer to the Umbwe River the path gets steeper, with views of Kibo Peak in the distance and the deep valleys all around you. After 5-7 hours the climb ends at Umbwe Cave Camp.

blocks.orig: Leave the rainforest and enter the heather with rocks and valleys around you. The ascent becomes steeper at the Umbwe Route Ridge and flattens out again near the Barranco Valley. After a 4 to 5-hour hike, you have dinner and overnight at the Barranco Camp in the valley below the Barranco wall.
blocks.html: You leave the rainforest behind and enter the heather zone, surrounded by rocks and valleys. At the Umbwe Route Ridge the climb gets steeper, then levels out again close to the Barranco Valley. After hiking for 4 to 5 hours, you have dinner and spend the night at the Barranco Camp, in the valley beneath the Barranco wall.

blocks.orig: This morning, you hike to the Barranco Wall where you have a spectacular view of the Kibo volcano to the left and Mount Meru to the right. Then a more difficult route to Karanga Camp begins, with many ascents and descents. Once at the camp, you have lunch and a couple of hours to rest. You can then go on a 300-meter acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp before descending back to Karanga Camp for the night.
blocks.html: This morning you walk to the Barranco Wall, which offers a spectacular view of the Kibo volcano on your left and Mount Meru on your right. After that, a more demanding stretch to Karanga Camp starts, with plenty of ups and downs. At the camp you have lunch and a few hours of rest. You can then do a 300-metre acclimatisation hike towards Barafu Camp before heading back down to Karanga Camp to sleep.

blocks.orig: On the fourth day on the mountain, you walk to Barafu Camp, the starting point for your summit push to Uhuru Peak. Arrive at the camp around noon, enjoy lunch, and take some time to rest. Later, go on another acclimatization walk to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870 m) before returning to Barafu Camp. Warm up with a hot dinner and relax for the rest of the day before starting the climb to the top of Kili at midnight.
blocks.html: Your fourth day on the mountain takes you to Barafu Camp, from where you make your summit push to Uhuru Peak. You reach the camp around midday, have lunch and rest for a while. Later on, you do one more acclimatisation walk to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870 m) before going back to Barafu Camp. A hot dinner warms you up, and you relax for the rest of the day before setting off for the top of Kili at midnight.

blocks.orig: Around midnight, you begin your final push to Uhuru Peak. Ascend along good trails while your guide keeps an eye on you to monitor your physical and mental state facing the altitude. Once you reach the top, enjoy a beautiful sunrise from the roof of Africa! After celebrating at the top, descend to the nearby glacier before returning through Barafu Camp and continuing the descent to Millennium Camp after a two-hour break.
blocks.html: At around midnight your final push to Uhuru Peak begins. You climb on good trails while your guide watches over you, checking how you are coping physically and mentally with the altitude. When you reach the top, take in a beautiful sunrise from the roof of Africa! After celebrating at the summit, you go down to the nearby glacier, then return via Barafu Camp and, after a two-hour break, carry on descending to Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: Millenium Camp is located in a tropical rainforest. Here you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit the day before. After breakfast, you walk to the national park's exit and your driver takes you back to the hotel, where you can recover from the rigors of the climb.
blocks.html: Millenium Camp lies in a tropical rainforest. Here you feel relief at the lower altitude and satisfaction at having reached the summit the previous day. After breakfast you walk to the exit of the national park, and your driver brings you back to the hotel to recover from the demands of the climb.

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Not ready to leave yet? You can also add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
